title: Asymptotic Behaviour for Isotropic Pearson Random Walks
summary: In the Pearson random walk the direction of the i-th step is a random variable uniformly distributed on the d-dimensional sphere, and its length is a non-negative random variable. In a general framework, we are going to study the asymptotic behaviour of the Pearson random walks when the dimension d goes to infinity. Further, we investigate the same convergence result in a more general framework, where both the number and the lengths of the steps depend on the dimension.
